sentences.text: Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:132003 Court No. - 1 Case :- CONTEMPT APPLICATION (CIVIL) No. - 5301 of 2024 Applicant :- Lal Bahadur Singh And 4 Others Opposite Party :- Mr Vinay Kumar Gupta, Special Land Acquisition Officer Counsel for Applicant :- Dinesh Kumar Pandey Hon'ble Salil Kumar Rai,J.
Heard the counsel for the applicants.
The present contempt application has been filed pleading willful disobedience of the order dated 25.10.2021 passed by this Court in Writ - C No. 23728 of 2021.
The relevant portion of the order dated 25.10.2021 is reproduced below : -

"After hearing learned counsel for the parties, the present writ petition is disposed of giving liberty to the petitioners to withdraw the compensation lying deposited with the competent authority on account of acquisition of land and super structure existing thereon in accordance with law.

As far as compensation for fruit bearing trees is concerned, the claim made by the petitioners may be referred to the Lal Bahadur Singh And 4 Others vs Mr Vinay Kumar Gupta, Special Land ... on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116417615/
1 Arbitrator within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this order."
